capabilities.name: Object Identity Intelligence
capabilities.production_caller: identity_workflow_node (production/identity_workflow.py) — wired into build_graph's composed advisory redirect chain
capabilities.inputs: campaign state channels: object_identity_observations, workflow_observations, crawled_data.openapi_routes (via endpoint_inventory_from_state)
capabilities.outputs: object_identity_registry channel (identities, relationships, abstentions, conflicts, stats)
capabilities.e2e_evidence: tests/test_umdr32_identity_workflow_integration.py::TestChannelContract + the evaluation lab alias metrics (4/4 resolved, 0 false merges)
capabilities.measurement: resolution precision 1.0 on the lab fixture (see UMDR32_BENCHMARK_RESULTS.json arm 'alias_resolution'); namespace separation held in every arm
capabilities.safety_boundaries: tenant boundary absolute; type boundary; path similarity never merges; id match alone never merges; abstention on weak evidence; conflicts preserved; bounded registry
limitations: path-derived resource types limit alias detection on schema-less targets (abstention is the honest outcome)
per-campaign-pass in-memory registry; no cross-campaign identity memory

capabilities.name: Alias / Alternate Representation Resolution
capabilities.production_caller: identity_workflow_node; the confirmed pairs feed identity_research_hints (stateful discovery ordering) and the cross-representation differentials
capabilities.inputs: the observation set + the identity registry
capabilities.outputs: identity_alias_graph channel (relationships with states, evidence, rejected interpretations)
capabilities.e2e_evidence: integration tests (hints flow into stateful_research_hints; confirmed pairs drive differentials that found V-ALIAS-701 in the lab)
capabilities.measurement: 4/4 ground-truth alias pairs confirmed, 0 false merges, query/namespace/type distinction held, abstain pair never confirmed (every arm)
capabilities.safety_boundaries: reversible states; cross-tenant/cross-type never merged; query-value distinctness preserved (F10/F11 non-regression); conflicts preserved not overwritten
limitations: same as object identity: schema-less targets reduce candidate corroboration
cross-representation differential execution is a harness-level path (the lab executor), not yet a graph node

capabilities.name: Multi-Identity Authorization Reasoning
capabilities.production_caller: identity_workflow_node (matrix + questions); the privilege_differential route: agents/validator/registry.py (registered) -> production/validators.py VALIDATORS dispatch -> production/experiment_fabric.py EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY
capabilities.inputs: identity_profiles / bac_identities channels, authorization_observations channel, identity-layer evidence
capabilities.outputs: multi_identity_reasoning channel (public principal projections, matrix coverage, differential questions); typed validator-input triples
capabilities.e2e_evidence: the evaluation lab: differential questions executed through run_validator('PRIVILEGE_DIFFERENTIAL') found V-IDOR-601 and V-XTENANT-501 (precision 1.0)
capabilities.measurement: 3/4 scenarios at the multi_identity arm (P=1.0); the missing-validator era is closed: validator_id_for('privilege_differential') != None and run_validator CONFIRMS the canonical triple
capabilities.safety_boundaries: pseudonymous principals (no raw credentials by construction — projection-checked); SessionBindingError on principal/session contamination BEFORE any request; questions require a negative control (no control -> abstain); matrix never fabricates unknown actors
limitations: differential question EXECUTION runs in the campaign harness path, not yet as an autonomous graph node (the hypotheses are in the pool; the strategist routes them)
role vocabulary maps the documented profile roles; exotic roles classify as UNKNOWN (honest)

capabilities.name: Composite Stateful Business Logic Workflows
capabilities.production_caller: identity_workflow_node (candidate generation); CompositeWorkflowEngine executes through the injected authorized client (the StatefulCaseProber client contract)
capabilities.outputs: composite_workflow_candidates channel (workflows + bounded sequences with invariants and controls); SequenceOutcome records
capabilities.tests: tests/test_umdr32_composite_workflows.py (18, incl. a live controlled HTTP fixture)
capabilities.e2e_evidence: the evaluation lab: the approval-invariant sequence found V-APPROVAL (policy_violation_candidate through the privilege-differential validator route with the negative-control probe)
capabilities.measurement: composite_workflow and unified arms: 4/4 scenarios, P=1.0, R=1.0; destructive steps never executed outside the safety contract (tested)
capabilities.safety_boundaries: FixtureSafetyContract (destructive requires resettable+isolated+operator-authorized+method-allowed); state-mutating sequences require resettable isolated fixtures; per-sequence request budget (<=24 hard) and time limits; two-route evaluation inside the EXISTING validation architecture (CausalGuard for same-actor state evidence; the registered privilege validator for cross-actor evidence); the engine never promotes
limitations: sequences derive only from OBSERVED transitions; unobserved preconditions are never invented (a missing transition stays missing)
the engine executes in the harness/campaign-worker path, not as a graph node (deliberate: execution stays under the authorized executor)
